functions.name: commit-manual-content
functions.purpose: Retired 2026-08-16 (Ideation Phase 6): superseded same-day by review-content-source, which approves manual/proof-led/AI-candidate content_sources rows uniformly into an unscheduled master row instead of committing straight to the Calendar. The underlying commit_manual_content RPC has been dropped; this directory has been removed from the repo.

functions.name: review-content-source
functions.purpose: Unified Sources approve/disapprove gate. Approve resolves a content_sources row (manual idea, proof item, or scored AI ideation candidate) into an unscheduled organic_master/story_master row via approve_content_source_to_master; reject parks it via reject_content_source. Neither writes calendar_cells -- only distribute-content-items-to-calendar ever schedules a row.

functions.name: distribute-content-items-to-calendar
functions.purpose: Bulk-reschedules selected Content Items (organic_master/story_master rows) across an operator-chosen date range, per content format and any approved Execution Ideation Schedule Contract.
